verdict.rationale: Edge compute is a fair axis for a deployment platform like Netlify, but the pack has no first-party documentation of edge functions written in Python, Go, Rust, or any non-JavaScript language. The only related item is a community complaint (netlify-comm-35) that language support is limited to 'JS/TS/Go or WebAssembly gimmicks.' That comment is about general platform functions, not edge functions specifically, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust
